name: International Society for Affective Disorders 14th Conference (next edition, unannounced)
description: ISAD holds a biennial international conference on mood disorders. The society website still lists the 12th conference (Milan, December 2023); a 13th conference is recorded by third parties for 2025 and no 14th conference has been announced as of September 2026.

sources.note: Society events page; most recent conference listed is ISAD 2023 Milan.
ISAD 2023 dates and deadlines (last verifiable edition).
Third party listing of a 13th conference (ISAD 2025) marked as over, without dates or city.
ISAD London 2025 regional meeting hosted by the KCL Centre for Affective Disorders.

notes: Could not verify dates or location of the 13th (2025) conference from an official page. Recheck isad.org.uk and the ISAD Facebook page for a 2027 announcement.
